answer: A hollow identity farm must burn the same capital per fake agent, so mass registration becomes economically self-defeating while honest participants amortize one stake over many useful tasks. Sybil resistance can be grounded in a proof-of-burn stake: each agent locks a real token amount to register, and that stake is destroyed, not refunded. Verification adds a cipher challenge the agent must sign and a comet-style timestamp beacon tying each registration to a fresh epoch, blocking replay of old proofs and making every forged identity cost real, unrecoverable value.
